bug_semantics: CWE-502 pickle RCE in the RehabPile dataset loader: load_rehab_pile_dataset (originally load_rehabpile) calls numpy.load on downloaded/local .npy files with allow_pickle=True, so a crafted npy/pickle is executed in-process. User interaction is required (open a malicious file or visit a page that triggers the load). GHSA-88rp-m596-52gg / CVE-2026-18285 / ZDI-26-468 (ZDI-CAN-28749) remain published (not withdrawn/rejected).
